E1 discusses dislocation slip in a different alloy (NbTaHfTiZrV0.5) and E2 reports modulus changes in a Ti-Nb-Mo-Sn alloy due to SIM transformation and precipitation, not thermal expansion mismatch. None of the key premises are supported by the provided passages.
premises: Cold rolling and aging introduce dislocations and nano-precipitates/SIM domains in HfNbTaTiZr
These defect-rich regions have a different thermal expansion coefficient than the matrix
